subject: science
description: 科学学科 MC 静态 fallback 示例（medium）

examples.label: 科学 MC medium：实验控制变量

block.questionText: A student tests whether fertilizer increases bean plant height. She places the fertilized plants on a sunny windowsill and the unfertilized plants in a shaded corner. Which flaw most seriously weakens her conclusion?

options.label: A
options.text: The sample includes too many bean plants.

options.label: B
options.text: Light exposure is not controlled between the two groups.

options.label: C
options.text: Bean plants are unsuitable organisms for controlled experiments.

options.label: D
options.text: Fertilizer should only be added after flowering begins.

block.solutionSteps: The experiment changes two variables at once: fertilizer and light. Because the fertilized group also gets more sunlight, the student cannot tell which factor caused any height difference. The lack of a controlled light condition makes B the best answer.
commonMistakes: Focusing on sample size instead of the uncontrolled variable.
Assuming the organism is the problem rather than the setup.
Suggesting a procedural preference that does not address the core confounding variable.

distractor_rationale.A: Scale confusion: a larger sample is not the main problem when the design has a confounding variable.
distractor_rationale.C: Method misunderstanding: bean plants can be used in controlled experiments if conditions are properly matched.
distractor_rationale.D: Irrelevant procedure change: it does not fix the fact that light exposure differs across groups.
